sentences.en: We have adequate inventories of the product to meet local demand.
sentences.zh: 我们有足够的存货来满足当地的市场需求。

sentences.en: After inventory, there was a net balance of three hundred pesos.
sentences.zh: 盘点后，净余额为三百比索。

sentences.en: To use an item simply click on its icon in the inventory.
sentences.zh: 要使用一项物品只需点击库存中的相应图标即可。

senses.zh: 详细目录，清单；存货，库存；盘货，存货盘点

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（进来）+vent（来）+ory（表物）→进来清查货物→目录
